RohitPuri

PROCESS ENGINEER|LEANSIXSIGMABLACKBELT|PROCESS EXCELLENCE& TRANSFORMATION

rohit.puri2194@gmail.com rohit.puri2194@gmail.com | +917018998533| https://www.linkedin.com/in/rohit-puri-80350010b

PROFILE SUMMARY:

Business Transformation and Process Excellence professional with 7 years of experience leading Digital Transformation, Quality Improvement, Change Management and Operational Optimization. Proven ability to lead large-scale projects across global regions, driving efficiency and innovation

Experienced in process and data discovery, Lean Six Sigma-based problem solving, statistical analysis and process redesign to identify productivity, efficiency, quality and automation opportunities and deliver measurable business outcomes.

Strong consulting, articulation, influencing and facilitation skills, with experience engaging stakeholders and senior/C-suite leadership to build alignment, communicate insights and drive transformation adoption.

Strong presentation development and delivery capabilities, including executive dashboards, transformation storyboards, KPI reviews and leadership presentations to communicate insights, progress, risks and business impact.

Experienced in developing and delivering LSS training and capability-building programs, mentoring cross-functional teams on improvement methodology, and driving adoption of a continuous-improvement culture across operations.

Lean Six Sigma Black Belt certified from Indian Statistical Institute, Pune with hands-on expertise in DMAIC, Kaizen, statistical process tools, FMEA and root-cause analysis and data-driven problem solving.

SKILLS

Lean Six Sigma

Process Discovery & mapping

RPA/AI/Gen AI /Agentic AI

Root Cause Analysis/Kaizen

LSS Training, Mentoring & Mobilization

Change Management

Continuous Improvement Culture

Data Analysis, Power BI

Process & system redesign

Stakeholder Management

Project Management

Risk Assessment & FMEA

EXPERIENCE

SENIORANALYST: MAGNITGLOBAL	(AUG 2024– JUN 2026)

Champion end-to-end business transformation and process re-engineering initiatives across workforce management, compliance, onboarding and shared-service functions spanning global regions, improving operational efficiency and service delivery.

Evaluate, redesign, and optimize business processes through process mapping, data analytics, root cause analysis and Lean Six Sigma tools to identify automation opportunities, eliminate inefficiencies and drive measurable outcomes.

Partner with global stakeholders and cross-functional teams across Operations, HR, Finance and Technology to prioritize initiatives, manage governance, and deliver sustainable business value.

Spearheaded digital transformation initiatives RPA, AI/Gen AI, Power BI and workflow automation solutions from opportunity assessment and business case development through implementation and Go-Live.

Designed executive dashboards, project storyboards, and KPI governance framework to track transformation benefits, support leadership decision-making and ensure realization of business objectives.

Facilitate change management, process standardization and continuous improvement programs through Kaizen, Lean Six Sigma, and best-practice deployment to enhance productivity, customer experience and operational performance.

Key Achievements: Delivered multiple automation and business transformation initiatives, generating over 6000 annual hours of savings, improving productivity by 50% and process accuracy by 35% across global operations.

ASSOCIATEMANAGER: AUTHBRIDGERESEARCH SERVICE PVTLTD	(JAN 2023– JUL2024)

Develop and implement Change Management strategies and planning for process re-engineering and improvement initiatives to enhance operational efficiency and productivity.

Applied analytical thinking to analyze and re-engineer operationa l process flows & also optimize processes by identifying the inefficiencies and bottlenecks to achieve desired outcomes.

Performed root cause analysis to identify process issues and challenges by applying knowledge of process flow mapping & data-driven insights.

Guided the development and governance of SOPs, improving process standardization and operational compliance.

Developed anddelivered training programs to support newprocesses and driveadoption.

Analyzed the feasibility of existing process for automation and collaborated with business teams to develop PDD (Process Definition Document) and SDD (Solution Design Documents)

Collaborated with business stakeholders to demonstrate RPA capabilities, identify automation opportunities, and support solution adoption

KEY PROJECT

Automated customer verification workflows, delivering annual cost savings of INR 18 lakh, reducing workforce requirements by 5 FTEs, and improving process accuracy by 4%.

Improved NPS from 51% to 60% through customer-focused process enhancement and service quality improvements.

Reduced TAT from 17 to 13 days using the DMAIC, contributing to a 40% reduction in client penalty costs.

SENIOREXECUTIVE: XPRESSBEES (BUSYBEESLOGISTICS SOLUTIONS PVT.LTD.)	(JUL2022– JAN 2023)

Facilitated building, deploying and mobilized a sustainable Continuous Improvement & Lean framework, Roadmap & Agenda for B2C business vertical.

Evaluated current and to-be-transitioned process including Process Flow chart, Value Stream Maps, Performance Metrics andtools to determine Gaps,Opportunities and Optimized Process performance (TAT, OFD Time, CSAT).

Led resource planning, process redesign, and implementation initiatives across last-mile operations.

Drove Initiatives to implement Standardization and 5S culture across Middle &Last Mile Service Center and prepare the SOPs for new processes.

Conducted progress analysis and attended monthly meetings regarding goals and tasks

KEY PROJECT

Improved Takt time by using MOST for the out-for-delivery (OFD) process by 35% inthe Last Mile.

Identified and proposed optimization affecting warehouse space management by 30% and a 37%-time reduction in truck loading using Operations and Facilities Design

ASSOCIATE ENGINEER:LUMINOUS POWER TECHNOLOGY PVT LTD	(OCT 2019– JUN 2022)

Improved the process efficiency by Cycle Time Study & MOST (Maynard Operation Sequence Technique)

Improved machine capacity through analyzing small elements of process and by minimizing abnormalities in machine-controlled elements.

Implemented SixSigmafor error elimination and Lean Methodology for process improvement.

Analyzed the process flow and troubleshot process problems to make continuous improvements.

Analyzed OEE and worked on productivity improvement initiatives within cross-functional teams.

Reviewed and strengthened implementation plans and business plans for Lean projects.

Prepared SOPs, Process Documents for new process implemented on the workplace.

Achieved the PLATINUM award for Luminous Power Technology in the state-level QC competition hosted virtually by CII in 2021.

KEY PROJECT

Redesign the process, improving charging productivity from 20 to 25 batteries/man- day.

Reduced manpower requirement by 30 operators per day through MOST study.

Reduced changeover time of initial assembly of battery line from 35 min to 16 minby implementing SMED technique.

CERTIFICATIONS

Certified as Lean Six Sigma Black Belt- Indian Statistical Institute, Pune

Certified as Digital Transformation (RPA/GEN AI/ AI) - The Brainstorm Academy (TBSA), Delhi

Certified as RPA- Process Automation Using UiPath from Udemy

Certified as Supply Chain Analytics- EXXPERTSCM EDUCATION

PUNJAB ENGINEERING COLLEGE, CHANDIGAR	(2017 –2019)

M.Tech, Production & Industrial Engineering – 8.61/10

LOVELY PROFESSIONAL UNIVERSITY, PHAGWARA	(2011 –2015)

B. Tech, Mechanical Engineering– 7.22/10

GOVT. SENIOR SECONDARYSCHOOL, BANGANA

Senior Secondary, 12th – 77%	(2010 –2011)

Higher Secondary, 10th – 75.4%	(2008 –2009)

ACHIEVEMENTS

\

1stPrizein theSIX SIGMA competition held atInter Plant Competition (Total 6 plants)

Qualified in Graduate Aptitude Technical Examination(GATE) thrice in 2015, 2017 & 2018in Mechanical Engineering

Among the top 5% of the students in GATE, 2017 with a score of 95 percentile in Mechanical Engineering

Awarded a scholarship of INR 12,400 per month during M.Tech.

sections.text:
EXPERIENCE
SENIORANALYST: MAGNITGLOBAL	(AUG 2024– JUN 2026)
Champion end-to-end business transformation and process re-engineering initiatives across workforce management, compliance, onboarding and shared-service functions spanning global regions, improving operational efficiency and service delivery.
Evaluate, redesign, and optimize business processes through process mapping, data analytics, root cause analysis and Lean Six Sigma tools to identify automation opportunities, eliminate inefficiencies and drive measurable outcomes.
Partner with global stakeholders and cross-functional teams across Operations, HR, Finance and Technology to prioritize initiatives, manage governance, and deliver sustainable business value.
Spearheaded digital transformation initiatives RPA, AI/Gen AI, Power BI and workflow automation solutions from opportunity assessment and business case development through implementation and Go-Live.
Designed executive dashboards, project storyboards, and KPI governance framework to track transformation benefits, support leadership decision-making and ensure realization of business objectives.
Facilitate change management, process standardization and continuous improvement programs through Kaizen, Lean Six Sigma, and best-practice deployment to enhance productivity, customer experience and operational performance.
Key Achievements: Delivered multiple automation and business transformation initiatives, generating over 6000 annual hours of savings, improving productivity by 50% and process accuracy by 35% across global operations.
ASSOCIATEMANAGER: AUTHBRIDGERESEARCH SERVICE PVTLTD	(JAN 2023– JUL2024)
Develop and implement Change Management strategies and planning for process re-engineering and improvement initiatives to enhance operational efficiency and productivity.
Applied analytical thinking to analyze and re-engineer operationa l process flows & also optimize processes by identifying the inefficiencies and bottlenecks to achieve desired outcomes.
Performed root cause analysis to identify process issues and challenges by applying knowledge of process flow mapping & data-driven insights.
Guided the development and governance of SOPs, improving process standardization and operational compliance.
Developed anddelivered training programs to support newprocesses and driveadoption.
Analyzed the feasibility of existing process for automation and collaborated with business teams to develop PDD (Process Definition Document) and SDD (Solution Design Documents)
Collaborated with business stakeholders to demonstrate RPA capabilities, identify automation opportunities, and support solution adoption
KEY PROJECT
Automated customer verification workflows, delivering annual cost savings of INR 18 lakh, reducing workforce requirements by 5 FTEs, and improving process accuracy by 4%.
Improved NPS from 51% to 60% through customer-focused process enhancement and service quality improvements.
Reduced TAT from 17 to 13 days using the DMAIC, contributing to a 40% reduction in client penalty costs.
SENIOREXECUTIVE: XPRESSBEES (BUSYBEESLOGISTICS SOLUTIONS PVT.LTD.)	(JUL2022– JAN 2023)
Facilitated building, deploying and mobilized a sustainable Continuous Improvement & Lean framework, Roadmap & Agenda for B2C business vertical.
Evaluated current and to-be-transitioned process including Process Flow chart, Value Stream Maps, Performance Metrics andtools to determine Gaps,Opportunities and Optimized Process performance (TAT, OFD Time, CSAT).
Led resource planning, process redesign, and implementation initiatives across last-mile operations.
Drove Initiatives to implement Standardization and 5S culture across Middle &Last Mile Service Center and prepare the SOPs for new processes.
Conducted progress analysis and attended monthly meetings regarding goals and tasks
KEY PROJECT
Improved Takt time by using MOST for the out-for-delivery (OFD) process by 35% inthe Last Mile.
Identified and proposed optimization affecting warehouse space management by 30% and a 37%-time reduction in truck loading using Operations and Facilities Design
ASSOCIATE ENGINEER:LUMINOUS POWER TECHNOLOGY PVT LTD	(OCT 2019– JUN 2022)
Improved the process efficiency by Cycle Time Study & MOST (Maynard Operation Sequence Technique)
Improved machine capacity through analyzing small elements of process and by minimizing abnormalities in machine-controlled elements.
Implemented SixSigmafor error elimination and Lean Methodology for process improvement.
Analyzed the process flow and troubleshot process problems to make continuous improvements.
Analyzed OEE and worked on productivity improvement initiatives within cross-functional teams.
Reviewed and strengthened implementation plans and business plans for Lean projects.
Prepared SOPs, Process Documents for new process implemented on the workplace.
Achieved the PLATINUM award for Luminous Power Technology in the state-level QC competition hosted virtually by CII in 2021.
KEY PROJECT
Redesign the process, improving charging productivity from 20 to 25 batteries/man- day.
Reduced manpower requirement by 30 operators per day through MOST study.
Reduced changeover time of initial assembly of battery line from 35 min to 16 minby implementing SMED technique.
